title: 잘 들리게 말해 주세요: '-게'로 목적 말하기
objective: By the end, you can add -게 and -지 않게 to verbs to say the purpose of an action ("so that … / so that … not …"). You can also choose -게 instead of -(으)러 when the action is not about going somewhere.
summary: Learn to use the connective ending -게 to say why you do something: "so that someone or something can …"

task.title: Use -게 for purpose
task.line: Read each item and fill in, choose, correct, or combine using the rules on page 1.

forms.when: The verb stem ends in a vowel: 들리다 → 들리게, 보이다 → 보이게
forms.example: 뒤에서도 잘 들리게 천천히 말해 주세요.
forms.exampleMeaning: Please speak slowly so that it can be heard well from the back too.

forms.when: The verb stem ends in a consonant. Just add -게, with no 으: 먹다 → 먹게, 앉다 → 앉게
forms.exampleMeaning: I left a little cake so that my younger sibling can have some too.

forms.when: You want to stop something from happening
forms.exampleMeaning: Leave early so that you won't be late.

forms.when: You do something to help another person (or a thing) do the action
forms.example: 다른 사람이 앉게 가방을 치워 주세요.
forms.exampleMeaning: Please move your bag so that someone else can sit down.

watchOut: 먹으게 (X) → 먹게 (O): Never add 으 before -게, even after a consonant.
들렸게 (X) → 들리게 (O): Do not put past tense before -게. Show the time on the last verb only (말했어요).
아이가 자러 조용히 했어요 (X) → 아이가 자게 조용히 했어요 (O): Use -(으)러 only with verbs of going or coming, such as 가다, 오다, 다니다, 나가다 (going somewhere to do something). For other actions, use -게.
exercises: Fill in the blank with 공부하다 + -게: 동생이 ____ 음악을 껐어요.
Fill in the blank with the negative form of 젖다 + -게: 비에 ____ 우산을 가져가세요.
Choose the correct form: 친구가 길을 (찾으게 / 찾게) 지도를 보내 줬어요.
Choose -(으)러 or -게: ① 빵을 (사러 / 사게) 가게에 가요. ② 아기가 (자러 / 자게) 불을 꺼 줬어요.
Find the mistake and correct it: 모두 잘 보였게 사진을 앞에 붙였어요.
Make one sentence with -게: 아이들이 손을 씻어요. / 엄마가 비누를 놓았어요.
answers: 보였게 → 보이게: 모두 잘 보이게 사진을 앞에 붙였어요.
아이들이 손을 씻게 엄마가 비누를 놓았어요. (엄마가 아이들이 손을 씻게 비누를 놓았어요.)
